title: Catan — one board, six seats
card: The landing for the Catan estate: six seats around one board, what has mass for each, and the queue of pages this dissection still owes.
lede: Catan will not fit one page and was never expected to. This is the section's index: six seats, each with a ranked gravity world, and a queue — two pages built, four still named absences. Open a seat for its world and for what the robber is from that chair.
handle: An explanation does not have a reader — it has a seat. The robber is a weapon to the strategist, a procedure to the rules lawyer and a drama dial to the publisher; a page written for 'everyone' has simply picked a seat without admitting it.
source: game numbers from the Catan base-game rules (3–4 player set); seat and world counts are this estate's own dissection — recount them on The dissection page.
